sections.text: Measure the alignment and record it.

Un couple the electric motor from the pump and lift it, lean it on a wooden 
 blokes to avoid damage of the half coupling.
Drain the oil from thrust support.
Dismantle the frame from the foundation base plate.

Sling the pump, lift it from the sump, leave it for a few minutes to drain it 
 completely.
Measure the radial clearance of blades and record it (0.5 1.25 mm).
